about: The machine-readable state of every proposed deviation from Taylor's blueprint.
docs/DEVIATIONS.md is the memo Taylor reads; this file is what the code checks.
It lives under context/architecture/ on purpose. protect-architecture.py lets this
file change only when Taylor's own latest message says `architecture change ok`,
so approving a deviation is itself an architecture change with his authority,
and the approval lands in CHANGE-LOG.md in the same turn.
`gates` names what stays switched off until the deviation is approved.
scripts/docs_edit.py refuses every write to a live (non-fixture) Doc while any
deviation gating `live_doc_writes` is not `approved`. An unreadable file is read
